maria (sec-eng): Heads-up: after the role-mapping rollout we just promoted, svc-analytics can read KMS-wrapped customer secrets via /kv/get. Repro steps below.

deploy-bot: role-mapper:v2 promoted to prod by asa at 2026-03-19T14:09:30Z

ken (platform): 🔎 can you paste the minimal repro and any logs? scope (single tenant vs multi-tenant)?

maria (sec-eng): Repro: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer svc-analytics-token" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/kv/get?key=customer:acct-123:db_password"
Response: 200 OK
{
  "value": "<kms-wrapped>...",
  "principal": "svc-analytics",
  "bindings": ["analytics-read", "secrets-reader"]
}
This should have returned 403. No external customer reports yet.

oliver (oncall): Ok urgent. Steps: 1) revoke offending binding from svc-analytics 2) kill long-lived sessions 3) snapshot audit log. Who can run revoke now?

asaction: (note: typo intentional in logs for realism)

asa (infra): I can run revoke. Suggested command: 
```
redwood rbac revoke-binding --principal svc-analytics --binding secrets-reader --env prod
```
I'll also queue rollback of role-mapper.

maria (sec-eng): audit snippet attached (from audit-bot):
```
2026-03-19T14:11:02Z audit: principal=svc-analytics action=kv.get resource=customer:acct-123:db_password result=allow proto=rbac rule_id=rm-merge-47
2026-03-19T14:11:05Z audit: principal=svc-analytics action=kv.get resource=customer:acct-456:api_key result=allow proto=rbac rule_id=rm-merge-47
```

aud it-bot: found 7 allow events from svc-analytics in last 5m.

ken (platform): If revoke works we still need to terminate tokens. Command: 
```
redwood sessions terminate --filter "principal=svc-analytics" --env prod --reason "emergency rbac revoke"
```

oliver (oncall): I'll run session termination and capture CA/conn logs. Doing now.

security-oncall: tagging legal/compliance. Potential PII exposure; keep this internal until we assess.

asa (infra): revoke completed ✅
redwood rbac revoke-binding returned 0
Binding secrets-reader removed from svc-analytics

maria (sec-eng): sessions terminated ✅
session termination returned 12 sessions killed (long-lived jobs).

audit-bot: snapshot stored to s3://redwood-audit/incident-1763005123/snapshot-20260319T1413Z.json

jess (product): Do we know which customers were affected? Need list for comms if required.

maria (sec-eng): From audit: acct-123 and acct-456 had reads. No outward alerts from customer-facing logs yet. I'll export query.

asa (infra): I also deployed a temporary deny-all policy for role-mapper service to prevent further merges: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch deployment role-mapper -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"role-mapper","env":[{"name":"RBAC_OVERRIDE","value":"deny_all"}]}]}}}}'
```
Effectively stops mapping worker.

ken (platform): That patch looks good as a short-term stopgap. We should rollback the role-mapper image to v1 (pre-change) next.

asa (infra): Rolling back now: deploy-bot: role-mapper:v1 promoted to prod by asa at 2026-03-19T14:22:10Z

maria (sec-eng): Root cause (prelim): PR 642 changed glob merge logic in role-mapping config. The merge used naive substring match which incorrectly merged "secrets-*" group into principal resolved for analytics service account. Bad example: mapping YAML snippet: 
```yaml
- match: ".*analytics.*"
  bind: [analytics-read]
- match: "secrets-*"
  bind: [secrets-reader]
# buggy merging code concatenated matches instead of isolating by principal namespace
```
In our case svc-analytics matched both patterns because of an internal naming tag `analytics-secrets-proxy` on the pod, so the merge assigned both binds.

asa (infra): I opened PR 645 to fix merge behavior to require full namespace anchored regex and a priority ordering. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/role-mapper/pull/645

oliver (oncall): Good. Preserve evidence: keep audit snapshot, revoke logs, and the failing mapping config. Do not purge. We'll need these for postmortem.

jess (product): Action items for comms: maria to draft internal summary + list of affected customers, legal to advise on disclosure.

maria (sec-eng): Draft will be ready in 1h. Tentative list: acct-123, acct-456. More queries running.

security-oncall: Please escalate to SOC and compliance. Add label P1-access-control.

ken (platform): Postmortem: RCA + timeline + rollout checklist to prevent similar merges. Also add unit tests for glob/regex behavior.

asa (infra): PR 645 includes tests and an emergency gate to require manual approval for mappings that add any secrets-* binding.

maria (sec-eng): Final note: no evidence of exfil beyond reads logged. We will continue 24h monitoring and run a full audit on KMS unwrap operations.

oliver (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll open an incident ticket: INC-2026-0421 and link this thread. Please add any updates there.

maria (sec-eng): INC-2026-0421 created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0421

asa (infra): sorry for the outage/chaos, will follow up with blameless postmortem. :bow:

ken (platform): Thanks team. Next steps assigned in ticket.

(reacts: :lock: :white_check_mark: :spiral_note_pad: )
